senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Esau, son of Isaac; (gent. noun) Esau (Edom), frequ. a disguise for Rome.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 38b:9">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite> <he>רשע דר … זה ע׳</he> a wicked man that dwelt between two righteous men without adopting their doings, that is Esau.

<cite ref="Gittin 57b:10">Gitt. 57ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 27:22">Gen. XXVII, 22</cite>) <he>אין לך … מזרעו של ע׳</he> there is no successful war in which descendants of Esau have no part.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 2:3">Gen. R. s. 2</cite> <he>ויהי ערב ערבו של ע׳</he> ‘and it was evening’ (<cite ref="Genesis 1:5">Gen. I, 5</cite>), the evening (decline) of Esau (Rome).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:7:1">Koh. R. to V, 7</cite> <he>אם ראית ע׳ בכרך הגדול של רומי עושק וכ׳</he> when thou seest Esau in the large city of Rome oppressing the poor and robbing the indigent &c.; a. fr.
